title: Count Numbers with Unique Digits
summary: For a given integer n, calculate the total count of numbers with distinct digits, ranging from 0 to 10^n minus one.
statement: For a given integer n, calculate the total count of numbers with distinct digits, ranging from 0 to 10^n minus one.
constraints: 0<=n<=13; counts saturate after ten written digits because no decimal digit may repeat.
Count integers x with 0<=x<10^n whose decimal digits are all distinct.
Leading zeros are not written as digits.
reference_solution:
def count_unique_digit_numbers(n):
    if n==0:return 1
    answer=10;ways=9;available=9
    for length in range(2,min(n,10)+1):ways*=available;answer+=ways;available-=1
    return answer
